title: Mapping profile
description: Vocabulary document: a versioned mapping between D2P identifiers or vocabulary terms and the terms of one edition of an external ontology, standard or industry convention (design decision ADR-005). A mapping translates to and from the canonical model; it never replaces or redefines a D2P term, and it is informative: a consumer never resolves a reference through it. It declares its provenance and carries no copied normative text or tables of the external system. Identified by 'mappingId' + 'version'; files live at mappings/<local-name>-<version>.json.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.1. Not schema-enforced: entries sorted by d2pTerm, then externalTerm (UTF-16 code-unit order); entry members are informative and not resolved by the referential level.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a mapping profile.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

mappingId.description: Qualified name of the mapping profile ('d2p:' for mappings published with the standard, an extension name for other publishers).

version.description: Version of this mapping profile, independent of the standard version and of the external system's edition.

description.description: Scope of the mapping and known limits.

system.description: Name of the external ontology, standard or convention.

systemVersion.description: Edition or version of the external system the mapping refers to.

provenance.description: Who published the mapping and where it is specified.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

mappingEntry.title: Mapping entry
mappingEntry.description: One correspondence between a D2P term and a term of the external system.

d2pTerm.description: The D2P side: an identifier (for example a measurement definitionId) or a vocabulary term (for example a feature type or layer role), as a qualified name.

relation.description: How the external term relates to the D2P term, after the SKOS mapping properties: 'exact' (interchangeable), 'close' (interchangeable in some contexts), 'broader' (the external term is broader), 'narrower' (the external term is narrower), 'related' (associated, not interchangeable).

externalTerm.description: Identifier or name of the term in the external system (never copied normative text).

note.description: Free-text remark, for example on differences between the definitions.

mappingRelation.title: Mapping relation
mappingRelation.description: Relation of a mapping entry (SKOS exactMatch, closeMatch, broadMatch, narrowMatch, relatedMatch).
